title: 13 Best Coffee Shops in Da Nang

venues.name: XLIII Specialty Coffee
venues.address: Lô 419, 422 Ngô Thì Sĩ, Bắc Mỹ An, Ngũ Hành Sơn, Đà Nẵng
venues.verdict: Da Nang's most serious specialty coffee — five years of uncompromising quality.
venues.whatToOrder: Pour-over with their current single-origin rotation. The cardamom sourdough pairs perfectly.

venues.name: O2o First Roast
venues.address: 18/3b, Phan Tứ, Bắc Mỹ An, Ngũ Hành Sơn, Đà Nẵng
venues.verdict: Speakeasy-style hidden gem with the highest Google rating in Da Nang (4.9★).
venues.whatToOrder: Cold brew with lemon — slightly acidic with hints of floral, orange, and raspberry.

venues.name: SẾU The Tearoom
venues.address: 01 Mỹ An 6, Bắc Mỹ Phú, Ngũ Hành Sơn, Đà Nẵng
venues.verdict: Serene Japanese-influenced matcha bar meets specialty coffee.
venues.whatToOrder: Their signature matcha or specialty coffee with Japanese brewing precision.

venues.name: Indigo Coffee
venues.address: 30 Bạch Đằng, Thạch Thang, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng
venues.verdict: Worth crossing the Han River for — a specialty cafe in the less-touristed Hải Châu district.
venues.whatToOrder: Current specialty pour-over. Pair with exploring nearby bò né breakfast spots.

venues.name: NAM House Cafe
venues.address: 15/1 Lê Hồng Phong, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng
venues.verdict: A vintage time capsule — antiques, nostalgia, and great traditional coffee.
venues.whatToOrder: Cà phê muối (salt coffee) in a beautiful vintage setting.

venues.name: Lu Coffee
venues.address: 62 Lê Quang Đạo, Bắc Mỹ Phú, Ngũ Hành Sơn, Đà Nẵng
venues.verdict: Best coconut coffee in Da Nang from a cozy neighborhood cafe.
venues.whatToOrder: The Coconut Coffee — thick Vietnamese coffee meets frozen coconut cream.

venues.name: Puna Specialty Coffee & Eatery
venues.address: 132 Lê Quang Đạo, Bắc Mỹ An, Ngũ Hành Sơn, Đà Nẵng
venues.verdict: The total package — excellent in-house roasted coffee, all-day brunch, cozy atmosphere.
venues.whatToOrder: Ethiopian and Vietnamese specialty blend — chocolate, plum, and caramel.

venues.name: Brewman Coffee Concept
venues.address: K27a/21, Thái Phiên, Phước Ninh, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng
venues.verdict: Sleek, modern, known for their deconstructed coconut coffee.
venues.whatToOrder: The deconstructed coconut coffee — served as separate components.

venues.name: Cà Phê Muối Huế
venues.address: 114 Nguyễn Văn Thoại, Bắc Mỹ Phú, Ngũ Hành Sơn, Đà Nẵng
venues.verdict: The essential salt coffee experience — opens at 5 AM.
venues.whatToOrder: Cà phê muối (salt coffee) and cà cao muối (salt cocoa).

venues.name: WONDERLUST Coffee & Souvenir
venues.address: 96 Trần Phú, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng
venues.verdict: Beautiful 3-story cafe with coffee, pastries, and souvenirs.
venues.whatToOrder: Vietnamese drip coffee with fresh pastries.

venues.name: Nối Café
venues.address: 113/18 Nguyễn Chí Thanh, Hải Châu, Đà Nẵng
venues.verdict: Most popular vintage cafe among young Vietnamese locals.
venues.whatToOrder: Cà phê trứng (egg coffee) — like a tiramisu in a cup.

venues.name: Lighthouse Coffee
venues.address: 12 Đ. Đình Nghệ, An Hải, Sơn Trà, Đà Nẵng
venues.verdict: Serious in-house roaster in a stunning brick building.
venues.whatToOrder: Compare their Vietnamese roast against the Campos Australian beans.

venues.name: Dng.coffee
venues.address: 05 An Thượng 2, Bắc Mỹ Phú, Ngũ Hành Sơn, Đà Nẵng
venues.verdict: The go-to laptop cafe for Da Nang's digital nomad community.
venues.whatToOrder: Colombian espresso — reliable chocolate and caramel notes.
